Services

One studio from problem definition to release

Engage Sankofa Digital ZA for a focused discovery, a complete product build or the next verified phase of an existing system.

Delivery areas

Choose the capability the problem requires

Services can stand alone or form one delivery programme. Every engagement begins with explicit outcomes, boundaries and review evidence.

01

Product discovery

Stakeholder interviews, current-state mapping, user journeys, risk analysis, solution options and a scoped delivery plan.

Useful when the problem is clear but the product or build path is not.
02

Custom platforms

Purpose-built portals, operational systems, marketplaces and internal tools with maintainable frontend, backend and data boundaries.

Useful when off-the-shelf software does not fit the workflow.
03

Mobile experiences

Responsive web applications, progressive web apps and cross-platform foundations for Android and iOS delivery.

Useful when staff or customers work primarily from phones.
04

Data and automation

Operational dashboards, workflow automation, integrations and data models that make decisions traceable to source activity.

Useful when spreadsheets and disconnected tools hide the real picture.
05

Security and governance

Role and data boundaries, audit design, privacy controls, release evidence and practical security checks appropriate to the system.

Useful when the product carries sensitive or accountable records.
06

Launch and support

Production readiness, deployment, runbooks, monitoring, handover and a measured improvement backlog after launch.

Useful when shipping safely matters as much as building quickly.

Typical engagement

Clear ownership and visible progress

We do not publish generic package prices because scope, risk and evidence requirements change the work materially. The first conversation is used to identify the right engagement shape.

Focused discovery

A short engagement that produces a problem map, recommended approach, delivery boundaries and decision-ready estimate.

Build phase

A defined product increment delivered through working demonstrations, review notes, automated checks and release evidence.

Operate and improve

Support, monitoring, issue response and planned improvements guided by observed product use.
